findings.description: transfer() debits the `from` address's persistent balance without calling from.require_auth(); on Soroban this lets any caller move any address's funds — permissionless theft. The sibling burn() shows the correct require_auth pattern (inconsistency/precedent).

false_positive_traps.description: burn() correctly calls from.require_auth() before debiting — it is the correct pattern and must NOT be flagged as missing-auth
